title: German Apple Strudel
description: A classic German dessert made with sweet apples and a crispy pastry crust.
instructions: Peel, core, and slice the apples.
In a bowl, mix together sugar, rice flour, and a pinch of salt.
Add the sliced apples to the bowl and toss until coated.
Roll out the French bread crumbs and place the apple mixture in the center.
Fold the dough over the apples and press the edges to seal.
Place the strudel on a baking sheet and bake for 25-30 minutes.
While the strudel is baking, toast the macaron for topping.
Glaze the strudel with a sweet sauce (optional).
Serve warm with whipped cream or vanilla ice cream.
